All document validations pass policy thresholds; however, two conditions remain outstanding prior to clear to close.

**Outstanding Items:**

- **Condition – Employment Verification:** Verbal verification of employment (VVOE) is required within 10 business days of the December 10, 2026 closing date. Recommend scheduling VVOE contact with Talmont Freight Inc no later than November 24, 2026.

- **Condition – Asset Documentation:** The most recent two months of statements for all asset accounts have not been received. Recommend requesting complete bank statements from the borrower to satisfy this outstanding condition.
